reason: Attacking for 4 forces a bad spot: if Gev blocks, the opponent trades their key engine for Curiosity, which comes back as a card-draw enchantment; unblocked, it deals 4 and draws a card. The second Curiosity in hand can be flashed in as a blocker.

At 4 life facing a flier, drawing three with harmonize (Excruciator can be the discard) digs for removal or a sweeper. Duress only hits a Burst Lightning or Erode in a hand of mostly creatures and does not stop the clock.
Not blocking takes 8 damage at 8 life and loses on the spot. Blocking one Hellkite with the 4/5 leaves you at 4 against an opponent at 1.
